name: Whole-cell patch amplifier
geometryBrief: Rack unit, headstages, pipette holders, connectors and computer control.
behaviorBrief: Clamp mode, series resistance, leak, capacitance and measured current or voltage.
inputs: Model-cell circuit (Ω, F), holding potential (V), clamp command (V or A)
outputs: Time series of measured current (A) or voltage (V), mode, bandwidth, saturation flags
acceptance: Use an ideal passive RC cell with compensation disabled. A current step should approach I × R with a time constant R × C. In voltage clamp, verify the steady leak current against the circuit.
geometryStatus: Metric 700B rack, CV-7B and PATCH-1U GLB; secondary details estimated
simulationStatus: Verified passive current- and voltage-clamp experiment; not hardware-validated
integrationStatus: Interactive station with primary-voltage handoff, downloadable schema and sample

name: Digitizer
purpose: Acquire analog patch-clamp signals and timing.
geometryBrief: Rack front/back, BNCs, LEDs, cables and PC.
behaviorBrief: Sampling, ADC range, timestamp and optional filtering; no hidden waveform generation.
inputs: Analog waveform (V), clock (s), channel map, ADC span and resolution
outputs: Integer ADC samples, time base, input-referred volts and clipping flags
acceptance: Digitize a voltage ramp crossing both rails. The interior codes should increase monotonically, out-of-range inputs should clip, and timestamps should be one sample period apart.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB; documented envelope, inferred connector details
simulationStatus: Ideal ADC, ramp and MultiClamp waveform verified analytically
integrationStatus: Simulator and input/output voltage handoff implemented; no headset validation

name: Single-channel amplifier
geometryBrief: Rack enclosure, knobs, headstage and input ports.
behaviorBrief: Stochastic channel events or supplied traces; clamp artifacts and noise.
inputs: Channel-state sequence or reference trace, unitary conductance (S), driving voltage (V), filter and noise settings
outputs: Filtered current (A), associated state timestamps when synthetic, noise bandwidth
acceptance: Feed closed, open and closed intervals longer than the filter settling time. With noise disabled the open plateau should differ from baseline by conductance × driving voltage.
geometryStatus: Metric Axopatch 200B 2U rack and CV203BU reference geometry
simulationStatus: Verified inert conductance steps through ideal Bessel output chain
integrationStatus: Interactive volt/current output, waveform JSON and named VR targets

name: Patch clamp alternate
geometryBrief: Amplifier, headstage, cable assembly and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Same underlying clamp model with different control presentation.
inputs: Shared clamp circuit, stimulus command, headstage gain and acquisition clock
outputs: Mode-tagged current or voltage trace, command log and headstage calibration ID
acceptance: Replay the passive model cell from 10-01 with identical settings. After conversion to SI units the EPC and MultiClamp adapters should agree within the common solver tolerance.

name: Upright slice microscope
geometryBrief: Objective, upright frame, XY stage, condenser, camera and focus controls.
behaviorBrief: Stage coordinates, focal plane, field of view and selected cell.
inputs: Slice volume ID, voxel spacing, stage pose, objective calibration and cell annotations
outputs: Calibrated focal-plane image, sample-space target position and selected cell ID
acceptance: Place labeled beads on two known planes. Moving focus between them should select the corresponding bead and return its coordinates within one image voxel.

name: Micropipette puller
purpose: Fabricate glass microelectrodes for intracellular experiments.
geometryBrief: Clamps, filament area, glass capillary, cover and touchscreen. Envelope listed as 53 x 36 x 30 cm.
behaviorBrief: Animate symmetric pulling; tip geometry and resistance estimate from calibrated models.
inputs: Capillary geometry, virtual pull preset ID, paired tip-profile and resistance calibration
outputs: Paired virtual pipette IDs, modeled taper geometry (m), estimated resistance (Ω) and calibration bounds
acceptance: Reserve measured pipette profiles for a blind comparison. Check predicted tip diameter and resistance against their predeclared uncertainty bands and flag extrapolated presets.

name: Motorized micromanipulator
purpose: Position patch pipettes or probes accurately.
geometryBrief: Three moving axes, mount, controller and encoder. Mechanical unit 11 x 15 x 16 cm; controller 40.6 x 27.3 x 9.6 cm.
behaviorBrief: Real stage travel and collision limits; map VR controls to sample coordinates.
inputs: Mount-to-sample transform, stage displacement (m), travel envelope and collision meshes
outputs: Tip pose in sample coordinates, actual displacement and travel or collision status
acceptance: Rotate the mount frame by 90 degrees and command a single-axis displacement. The sample-space axis should rotate accordingly and a command past its calibrated travel should stop at the limit.

name: Microelectrode beveler
purpose: Refine glass electrode tips when appropriate.
geometryBrief: Abrasive plate, holder, microscope, adjustable stage and controller.
behaviorBrief: Tip geometry and resistance change as a modeled estimate.
inputs: Pipette ID, initial tip geometry and a matched before/after bevel calibration set
outputs: Child tip revision, modeled bevel surface and estimated resistance (Ω)
acceptance: Replay a held-out tip pair. Compare estimated opening area and resistance change with measured before/after values and retain uncertainty for each quantity.

name: Multichannel stim/record
purpose: Independently stimulate and record neural electrodes.
geometryBrief: Rack controller, four front headstage ports, red cables, headstage PCBs, adapters and I/O.
behaviorBrief: Channel assignment, biphasic stimuli, measured impedance, noise, artifact and timing; up to 128 system channels.
inputs: Headstage configuration, electrode map, per-channel stimulus events, load model and reference signals
outputs: Channel-indexed voltage traces (V), delivered current events (A), impedance estimates (Ω) and timestamps
acceptance: Route one balanced biphasic command to a known resistive dummy channel. Integrated net charge should be zero within time-step error and the channel response should match I × R in the unclipped ideal fixture.
geometryStatus: Built: metric 1U M4200 and static M4016/M4032 witnesses
simulationStatus: First pass: verified read-only synthetic alignment; stimulation outside scope
integrationStatus: Linked: channel picker, JSON/CSV and scope handoff

name: Open acquisition system
geometryBrief: PCB, case, ports, headstages and I/O modules; obtain licensed design files.
behaviorBrief: Stream simulated or real extracellular data through an explicit acquisition pipeline.
inputs: Extracellular sample stream, event clock, channel map and buffer configuration
outputs: Timestamped channel blocks, event markers and detected acquisition gaps
acceptance: Replay a numbered multichannel ramp with one missing block and one trigger. Reassembly should retain channel order, flag the gap and place the trigger at the original sample.

name: High-density CMOS MEA
purpose: Record spatially distributed neural activity in culture or tissue.
geometryBrief: Hub 185 x 280 x 90 mm; recording unit 150 x 95 x 25 mm; separate chip/well and holders.
behaviorBrief: Electrode selection, signals and activity maps; 26,400 physical sites and 1,020 recording channels, not simultaneous recording of all sites.
inputs: Chip/site map, selected recording routes, specimen ID and spatial signal field
outputs: Routed channel traces (V) and an activity map with unsampled sites masked
acceptance: Place a single synthetic source on a known routed site. It should appear at that coordinate. Attempting to route 1,021 simultaneous recording channels should reject the configuration or demand another acquisition.

name: Multiwell HD-MEA
purpose: Compare multiple cultures or organoids in parallel.
geometryBrief: Well plate, docking unit, electronics and software; verify variant dimensions.
behaviorBrief: Per-well data and longitudinal comparison; lazy-load inactive cultures.
inputs: Multiwell layout ID, independent specimen IDs, channel selections and session timeline
outputs: Per-well activity maps and traces keyed to specimen, well and session
acceptance: Replay a spike train in one well and silence in another, then unload and revisit both. No spikes should cross wells and both timelines should retain their original sample counts.

name: High-density silicon probe
purpose: Record distributed extracellular spikes and field potentials.
geometryBrief: Shank, electrode sites, flex, headstage and metal cap; use separate documented version geometry.
behaviorBrief: Contact selection and recording model; 1.0 is a recording probe, not a generic stimulator.
inputs: Probe variant and site-map revision, bank selection, shank pose and extracellular field
outputs: Recording channels (V) mapped to physical contact IDs and 3D locations
acceptance: Replay a depth-coded field and switch banks. Each channel should report the value at its selected physical site. Verify against the exact 1.0 or 2.0 map used in that run.

name: Peripheral nerve recording bath
model: Custom organ-bath rig with recording and stimulation cuffs
purpose: Evaluate compound action potentials and selective recruitment.
geometryBrief: Transparent bath, supports, cuff or intraneural contacts, perfusion, temperature probe and micromanipulators.
behaviorBrief: Couple nerve FEM/axon models, recruitment, latency, spatial selectivity and noise. Ground truth may be simulated only.
inputs: Nerve geometry and axon population, cuff contact map, pulse events, conductivity and acquisition clock
outputs: Compound action potential (V), recruitment by population, propagation latency (s) and model provenance
acceptance: Use identical synthetic axons with known conduction velocity and two recording positions. The latency difference should equal separation divided by velocity within sampling and solver resolution.

name: Isolated pulse stimulator
purpose: Represent separate stimulation source for isolated experimental circuits.
geometryBrief: Panel controls, outputs, cables and load fixture.
behaviorBrief: Pulse timing, polarity and compliance; interface with virtual electrode safety checks.
inputs: Requested pulse train, isolated-load circuit, output mode and compliance limit
outputs: Time-resolved delivered voltage and current, polarity, compliance events and delivered charge (C)
acceptance: Drive a synthetic resistor in current mode within compliance and then beyond compliance. Confirm V = IR in the first trace and a flagged voltage-limited response in the second.

name: Vibrating tissue slicer
purpose: Represent preparation of acute slices for recording.
geometryBrief: Blade holder, bath, specimen stage and controller.
behaviorBrief: Virtual section geometry and specimen tracking; not a live-tissue protocol.
inputs: Virtual specimen volume, cutting plane, requested thickness (m) and specimen transform
outputs: Ordered child slice IDs, plane transforms, extents and parent volume reference
acceptance: Section a labeled cuboid in the virtual fixture. Slice extents should cover the requested interval without overlap and each landmark should map back to its parent coordinate.
